mechanism: Celecoxib may reduce the antihypertensive efficacy of guanfacine through inhibition of renal prostaglandin synthesis and fluid retention, while guanfacine may increase celecoxib levels via CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly; consider alternative analgesic if hypertension control deteriorates; assess renal function periodically as both drugs affect renal hemodynamics.
